TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
there were two barbers, one with a good haircut and one with a bad haircut, and I chose the one that used AI
the single most important thing for the survival of the galactic spaceship is a magazine of ideas
What so many have experienced personally has been confirmed by a new study: AI has been a disaster for working artists.

"The loss of local media in particular is associated with greater loneliness, lower awareness of public officials, and more corruption. It’s like an invisible tax levied on our communities.... Increasingly, this invisible tax is being silently levied by Big Tech."
Thank you my friend!

I think about this a lot. I talk to non-journos who give me half-surfaced versions of current events, and it’s hard for good info to find them. And they’re relatively high-functioning professionals! If navigating the info economy is hard for them, how does it work for people with fewer advantages?

I wrote about being inundated with AI writing at every turn, unwittingly turning my brain into the AI police, and how shitty AI writing is randomly showing up in my real life outside of the internet

www.404media.co/your-ai-use-...

Apparently one of the knocks is that some of it would have been written differently / less confidently after the replication crisis, but there are several stages of the book (like the last one about memories) that just drop whole different heavy paradigms on you that really make you think.

I read some behavioral economics and it has made the Sunday essay more powerful than you could possibly imagine. 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/you-couldn...
Daily bunny no.3314 is seeks great wisdom
Star Wars remake where Vader is force-choking underlings for not moving faster on deregulating vapes
I am a smug English major with a fine arts degree and sociology masters, someone hire me lol
insanely smug English majors are the only ones who haven’t rotted their brains too much to do investment banking. our time
Photo by @nicolehester.bsky.social for The Tennesseean www.tennessean.com/picture-gall...
literally only the good surveillance AI is the one on my phone that tells me what the bird is

I am once again here to preach the good word that Thomas Pynchon is a gorgeously readable writer and also probably the greatest american prose stylist of at least the last 50 years and people who tell you his books are calculus tests for boys don’t love you and Vineland is a great place to start

This is such good reporting from Mia. Clipping is a hallmark of what I'm starting to think of as the anti-social web: the sheer volume crowds out content from people you know (fulfilling demand from the platforms) and the clips themselves are more a product of The Algorithm than the clipped text.
